data.description: Gather valuable zero-party data from your customers that you can use to personalize your campaigns. This use case features a 100% no-code banner with a large number of customization options. Set the questions you’d like to ask and get the insights you need to create personalized experiences that improve conversions.
data.name: Zero-Party Banner

template.callout: One customer saw a 31.1% boost in conversion rate after personalizing its emails with zero-party data from this banner.
